The '''Mecetti House Guard''' was the [[House Guard]] that served [[House Mecetti]]. A combined [[Army/Legends|army]] and [[Navy/Legends|naval force]], the Mecetti House Guard's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was known as the [[Guard Navy]].<ref name="LE" /> [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] from the organizations were patrons of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Saludi's]], in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Undercity]]. The men who served in it were arrogant and disdainful of anyone who was not from House Mecetti.<ref name="CD">{{LivingForce|Coruscani Dawn}}</ref>
